nodes.name: espn_mbb_athletes.R
nodes.summary: ESPN men's college basketball athlete endpoint wrappers (espn_mbb_player_info, _overview, _stats_v3, _gamelog, etc.), returning per-player bio, overview, V3 stats and game-log frames from ESPN's web/core athlete APIs.

nodes.name: espn_mbb_awards.R
nodes.summary: ESPN MBB awards wrappers (espn_mbb_season_awards, espn_mbb_award) that fetch season award lists and single-award detail from ESPN's core awards endpoints.

nodes.name: espn_mbb_calendar.R
nodes.summary: Single-function wrapper (espn_mbb_calendar) returning the ESPN MBB season calendar of date ranges and season types for a given season.

nodes.name: espn_mbb_coach.R
nodes.summary: ESPN MBB coach wrappers (espn_mbb_coach, espn_mbb_coach_record) that fetch a coach's profile and win/loss record from ESPN's core coach endpoints.

nodes.name: espn_mbb_data.R
nodes.summary: Core ESPN men's college basketball data module: play-by-play, team/player box scores, game rosters, scoreboard, schedule, teams, conferences, rankings, standings, betting and team/player stats, plus the helper parsers that flatten ESPN summary payloads.
nodes.languageNotes: Large endpoint module (~3.8k lines, 17 exports) pairing public espn_mbb_* fetchers with private helper_espn_mbb_* parsers; extensive roxygen returns-tables document each output frame.

nodes.name: espn_mbb_event_detail.R
nodes.summary: ESPN MBB per-event (game) detail wrappers (odds, win probabilities, officials, broadcasts, and other event sub-resources) drawn from ESPN's core event endpoints.

nodes.name: espn_mbb_franchise.R
nodes.summary: ESPN MBB franchise wrappers (espn_mbb_franchises, espn_mbb_franchise) listing all program franchises and fetching a single franchise's detail.

nodes.name: espn_mbb_futures.R
nodes.summary: Single-function wrapper (espn_mbb_futures) returning ESPN MBB season futures betting markets for a given season.

nodes.name: espn_mbb_groups_v2.R
nodes.summary: ESPN MBB v2 group/conference wrappers (espn_mbb_season_groups, espn_mbb_season_group, and children) resolving conference and grouping hierarchies for a season.

nodes.name: espn_mbb_injuries.R
nodes.summary: ESPN MBB injury wrappers (espn_mbb_injuries, espn_mbb_team_injuries) returning league-wide and per-team injury reports.

nodes.name: espn_mbb_league.R
nodes.summary: ESPN MBB league-level index wrappers (espn_mbb_leaders, espn_mbb_venues, espn_mbb_coaches, espn_mbb_athletes_index, and more) exposing season-wide leaders, venues and entity directories.

nodes.name: espn_mbb_news.R
nodes.summary: ESPN MBB news wrappers (espn_mbb_news, espn_mbb_team_news) returning league and team headline feeds.

nodes.name: espn_mbb_positions.R
nodes.summary: ESPN MBB position wrappers (espn_mbb_positions, espn_mbb_position) listing roster positions and fetching a single position's detail.

nodes.name: espn_mbb_powerindex.R
nodes.summary: Single-function wrapper (espn_mbb_powerindex) returning ESPN's MBB power index team ratings for a season.

nodes.name: espn_mbb_season_meta.R
nodes.summary: ESPN MBB season metadata wrappers (espn_mbb_season_types, espn_mbb_season_type, and children) describing a season's structure, types and associated sub-resources.

nodes.name: espn_mbb_team_deep.R
nodes.summary: ESPN MBB deep team-resource wrappers (espn_mbb_team_odds_records, espn_mbb_team_season_roster, and more) exposing season-scoped team odds records and rosters from core team endpoints.

nodes.name: espn_mbb_team_detail.R
nodes.summary: ESPN MBB team detail wrappers (espn_mbb_team, espn_mbb_team_roster, espn_mbb_team_schedule, espn_mbb_team_leaders, etc.) returning a single team's profile, roster, schedule and statistical leaders.

nodes.name: espn_mbb_team_record.R
nodes.summary: Single-function wrapper (espn_mbb_team_record) returning a team's season win/loss record splits from ESPN's core team record endpoint.

nodes.name: espn_mbb_tournaments.R
nodes.summary: ESPN MBB tournament wrappers (espn_mbb_tournaments, espn_mbb_tournament, and children) listing postseason tournaments and resolving a single tournament's bracket/detail.

nodes.name: espn_mbb_weeks.R
nodes.summary: ESPN MBB scheduling-week wrappers (espn_mbb_season_weeks, espn_mbb_season_week, and children) enumerating a season's weeks and per-week sub-resources.

nodes.name: espn_mbb_wp.R
nodes.summary: Single-function wrapper (espn_mbb_wp) that extracts ESPN's per-game win-probability time series for a men's college basketball game.

nodes.name: espn_nba_athlete_career.R
nodes.summary: ESPN NBA athlete career wrappers (espn_nba_player_seasons, espn_nba_player_career_stats, and more) returning a player's season list and career statistical history.

nodes.name: espn_nba_athlete_contracts.R
nodes.summary: ESPN NBA athlete contract wrappers (espn_nba_player_contracts, espn_nba_player_contract) returning a player's contract list and single-contract detail.

nodes.name: espn_nba_athletes.R
nodes.summary: ESPN NBA athlete endpoint wrappers (espn_nba_player_info, _overview, _stats_v3, _gamelog, etc.) returning per-player bio, overview, V3 stats and game-log frames; NBA mirror of espn_mbb_athletes.R.

nodes.name: espn_nba_awards.R
nodes.summary: ESPN NBA awards wrappers (espn_nba_season_awards, espn_nba_award) that fetch season award lists and single-award detail; NBA mirror of espn_mbb_awards.R.
